image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming near a rocky reef. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines. The background consists of textured coral or rock formations.
